description: Turn a plain-English description into Mermaid diagram source. Describe the flow, system, schema or timeline you want ("a login flow with an OAuth branch and a failure path") and get back complete, valid Mermaid - no need to know the syntax. The mermaid field of the response is directly usable as the mermaid_source input of convert_diagram, so describe -> render is a two-call pipeline. Generation runs on our infrastructure via AWS Bedrock; your description is not sent to any third-party service beyond that.

description.description: What the diagram should show, in plain language. Include the nodes/steps/entities you care about; the generator fills in sensible structure.

diagram_type.description: Force a specific Mermaid diagram type. Default "auto" - the generator picks the type that fits the description.

name: describe_diagram
